data.name: SystemDescription
data.value: Used to manage human resources in manufacturing plants and ensure effective assignment and arrangement of workers on production lines.

data.name: FeaturesTitle
data.value: This system typically includes the following features:

data.name: Feature1
data.value: 1. Personnel Data Management: Record employee basic information, skills, and experience.

data.name: Feature2
data.value: 2. Production Scheduling: Assign employees to appropriate workstations based on production plans and line requirements, ensuring adequate staffing at each station.

data.name: Feature3
data.value: 3. Work Progress Tracking: Track employee work progress and product flow on the production line, adjusting assignments promptly to address any production line issues.

data.name: Feature4
data.value: 4. Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze employee performance and production line efficiency, providing reports and data to help management make better decisions.

data.name: Feature5
data.value: 5. Safety and Monitoring: Monitor the work environment and employee safety on the production line to ensure all operations comply with safety standards.

data.name: SystemBenefits
data.value: Using the production line online dispatch system can improve production line efficiency and product quality while reducing errors and work delays in the production process.

data.name: SOPDescription
data.value: Standard operating procedure documents compiled and managed on digital platforms. These procedure documents describe in detail the workflow for executing tasks to ensure consistency and efficiency.
